description: This Java class 'Node' manages hierarchical configuration data using key-value pairs, supporting type conversions, property management, and serialization support.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a hierarchical configuration node with properties stored as strings, supporting type conversions and nesting.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Default constructor, needed for XML serialization.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Constructor for creating a child node with a given prefix, linked to a parent map.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be parsed as a number.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a child node with a specific name.

methods.name: getIntProperty
methods.description: Retrieves an integer property value, returning a default if parsing fails.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property with an overload that specifies a default value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value with different overloads for String, int, boolean, and double types.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value as String, with an overload that provides a default.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the node's prefix (for serializer use).

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the node's prefix (for serializer use).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node.

methods.name: getDoubleProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a double property, returning a default if not numeric.
